[{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a Hive board game expert. Determine if the game has ended and who won.'}, {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Board state:
White Queen Bee is at position c3.
Surrounding c3 (all 6 hexes occupied): Ab2, Bc2, Sc4, Ad3, Bd4, Ac3-on-top-by-black-beetle

Black Queen Bee is at position f3.
Surrounding f3 (5 of 6 hexes occupied): Se2, Af2, Gf4, Se3, Ad3-shared

Is
dataset_example.answer: The game is a DRAW. Both Queen Bees are completely surrounded simultaneously. In Hive, if both Queen Bees are surrounded at the same time, the game ends in a draw. White's Queen Bee at c3 has all 6 adjacent hexes occupied. Black's Queen Bee at f3 also has all 6 adjacent hexes occupied (the d3 hex is shared between both clusters).
